test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ______ of directors gave their approval for the project.
solution:
The correct answer is 'board'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence needs an appropriate word to be filled in the given blank.
 
• The marked option 'board' means a group of persons having supervisory, managerial, investigatory, or advisory powers.
 
• Board is actually a one-word substitute for the group of people who are responsible for controlling and organizing a company or organization.
 
• So, it fits well in the given context and is the most appropriate word to fill the given blank.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 2.**
